Maia vs Grok Bot

Team work in Slack or a cloud computer?

Grok Bot gives each account a fleet of agents on one persistent cloud computer. Maia keeps shared company work visible in a Slack channel and its threads.

The short answer

Grok Bot is xAI's computer-using agent product. A user's Bots share one persistent cloud computer, run in parallel, learn demonstrated routines, and coordinate. Maia takes a different approach. A Slack channel has a coworker with shared instructions, memory, tools, and approval rules.

Choose Grok Bot when work depends on websites without useful APIs and an agent needs a persistent browser and files. Choose Maia when requests should begin in a shared channel, stay visible to the team, and pause there for review.

An anomaly investigation

A growth team notices that ad spend rose while attributed signups fell. The inputs are a supplied performance export, the approved budget, campaign notes, and a tracker. The desired result is an explanation limited to the available data and a reviewed tracker update.

With Maia, a teammate asks in the growth channel. The channel coworker applies that team's metric definitions, compares the records, and posts findings with source links. Teammates can challenge an attribution assumption in the same thread. If the tracker write needs approval, Maia presents the proposed change to the configured reviewer before acting.

Grok Bot is well suited when the investigation requires logging into several web dashboards that do not offer APIs. A user can demonstrate a routine, let Bots work in parallel, and return when approval is needed. The work centers on the user's cloud computer and account, while Slack can trigger a routine or receive a post through the connected user's identity.

Choose Maia when

Choose Maia when the team's conversation is the main work record. A channel can teach its coworker how to interpret metrics, which sources are authoritative, and who may approve changes. Other people in the channel can see the request and continue the work without inheriting one person's computer session.

Maia also fits organizations that want model choice and user-scoped business app access. Test each proposed connection, identity, and approval path with the real destination system before rollout.

Choose Grok Bot when

Choose Grok Bot when browser operation is central. The persistent computer can hold files and sessions, and multiple Bots can coordinate on that shared environment. xAI also describes routines that users teach by demonstration, mobile and desktop access, and team plans with centralized settings and shared usage analytics.

The Slack plugin is meaningful, but Slack is not the primary Grok Bot conversation surface. It can post only where the connected Slack user can post, and every Bot on that account can use the plugin. That may be exactly right for a personal agent fleet, but it differs from a channel-owned coworker.

Review identity and risk

Ask whose identity each product uses in Slack and in external systems. With Grok Bot, plugins belong to the account and its Bots share the persistent computer. xAI documents Auto Review for sensitive actions. With Maia, the intended model uses requester connections, channel policy, and review in the Slack thread.

Run a test where access differs between two teammates. Include a proposed write and a revoked permission. Review the action log, the approval prompt, and the final author shown in the destination. This exposes more than a checklist of integrations.

Common questions

Is Grok Bot a Slack bot?

Grok Bot has a Slack plugin and Slack messages can trigger routines. Its main product experience is a computer-using agent fleet across desktop and mobile apps.

Do Grok Bots share context?

All Bots for one user share one persistent cloud computer. xAI says files, browser state, and logins are isolated by user rather than by Bot.

Which product is better for websites without APIs?

Grok Bot has the clearer fit because computer and browser use are central to the product. Maia is stronger when an authorized connected app can carry out the work and the Slack channel should supervise it.
